final: WITH player_counts AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON (pa.player_id COLLATE BINARY) = (p.player_id COLLATE BINARY) GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), hand_totals AS (SELECT bats, SUM(award_count) AS hand_total FROM player_counts GROUP BY bats), shares AS (SELECT pc.player_id, pc.bats, pc.award_count, CAST(pc.award_count AS REAL) / ht.hand_total AS share FROM player_counts AS pc JOIN hand_totals AS ht ON (pc.bats COLLATE BINARY) = (ht.bats COLLATE BINARY)), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.player_id, s.bats, s.award_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10
